findings.detail: FR-001's Compliance boundary is marked TBD for 'Retention period for attestation records', but kb-L1-enterprise-security § ES3 already states trade/compliance-relevant records (attestations included) must be retained 6 years from creation, per Group Records Retention Policy — a real, checkable source the generator did not check before writing TBD.

FR-003's Availability boundary is marked TBD for 'Availability SLA for traceability records', but kb-L1-enterprise-security § ES4 already states any new system storing a legally-relevant audit/compliance record that could be required for active regulatory defence must target 99.9% uptime — directly applicable to this immutable traceability record.

FR-008's Availability boundary is marked TBD for 'Availability tier for the reporting pipeline', but kb-L1-enterprise-security § ES4 already states an outbound-only reporting pipeline that is not itself a compliance record gets best-effort / group Tier 3 equivalent — directly applicable to FR-008's time-to-first-compliant-trade reporting feed.
